svg.text: Detects merchant accounts used as an undisclosed payment-processing front for hidden third parties and unscreened principals.

g.text: • Boarded MCC vs actual txn types
• Processed volume multiples of declared profile
• Transaction mix inconsistent with boarded MCC
BA009 detects merchant accounts used as an undisclosed
payment-processing front. It quantifies processed volume
against the declared business profile, the count of
unrelated sub-merchants funnelled through, and corroborates
the finding with MCC inconsistency and a refund/chargeback
pattern inconsistent with genuine commerce. Pass-through
processing for an undisclosed principal is surfaced and
escalated for enhanced due diligence and SAR filing.

svg.text: BUILDING THE FOUNDATION FOR NETWORK INTELLIGENCE AND GRAPH-BASED FINANCIAL CRIME INVESTIGATIONS
